title: ShaderFamily cache keys omit content-only environment toggles
body: VIXEN_SDF_COVERAGE_DEBUG was injected by the lighting source provider but reused the ordinary cached SpatialReuseShade pipeline because the environment-controlled source splice was not part of the typed feature key; I had to duplicate the define on the feature axis to force a distinct cache entry.

title: Lookdev capture budget is too low for required high-resolution evidence
body: The registered four-angle capture defaults to 8 frames per angle and a 300000 ms process budget; a queued 1000x1000 witness exceeded the budget after writing its images, requiring VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_FRAMES=1 and VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_BUDGET_MS=900000 plus an angle-specific direct invocation. Suggested consolidation: expose a bounded evidence mode or resolution-aware budget in the registered capture wrapper.
